title: Record
description: One unit of runtime output as a descriptor reads it: the source it came from and the record itself. The shape of the lines a hook forwarder writes to the local socket, and of a descriptor fixture's records.jsonl.

source.description: output for a JSON line the runtime printed on its standard output; hooks for the JSON a hook command received on its standard input.

record.description: The JSON object as the runtime produced it, unchanged.
